snippet.title: CornerShop: NightShift - Cinematick + Gameplay [English VO + subs]
snippet.description:
Corner Shop: NightShift is a psychological horror sim set in a not-so-quiet night store.
A game about work, exhaustion, and the struggle to rebuild when everything around you starts to fall apart.

🕯️ Narrative-driven horror
🌙 Late-shift loneliness
🛒 Sim elements with a disturbing twist
🎮 Built in Unreal Engine 5

Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3306990/Corner_Shop_NightShift/
